verification_oracle: all mapped acceptance_ids pass on the exact target subject; UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN never count as PASS

results.note: A random per-user DEK is wrapped by the master KEK under AES-256-GCM and a provider sub-key is derived per provider. User id, provider id and key version are bound into the AAD, so a ciphertext lifted into another user or provider scope is refused in constant time, and a wrong master key fails authentication. Rotation preserves readability, crypto-shred makes residual ciphertext unreadable for that user only, key material is zeroed after use, and the only plaintext fragment stored is the last four characters.

OpenAI uses the fixed official Responses endpoint with store:false. The model must be in the server-owned allowlist; a rejected model never reaches the network, and a non-official or non-bare-HTTPS origin cannot be configured at all.
DeepSeek reuses the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions implementation rather than forking it, with its own pinned origin and model policy.
Gemini authenticates with the x-goog-api-key header; the key never appears in the URL, where it would land in access logs. Usage normalises from usageMetadata.
Anthropic uses the Messages API with a pinned anthropic-version header and the server-owned model allowlist.

401/403, 402, 429 and 5xx map to distinct codes with fixed Chinese messages. The diagnostic hashes provider, status and body length only — never body content. The controller applies a bounded default timeout; a timeout counts as provider evidence while an external cancel does not touch the circuit.

The input estimate is a conservative UTF-8 byte upper bound. The circuit is consulted, then the limit check and reservation execute inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, and only then is the provider called. Over-budget and oversized requests are denied with modelCalls 0 and a Chinese repair action; the suite counts zero provider calls on every denial.

All four providers' usage fields normalise to one shape. Missing usage charges the full reservation, a reservation orphaned by a crash is charged in full once its TTL passes, and an uncertain transport outcome charges rather than releases. request_id idempotency is scoped to the user, so a replay is refused while the same id from another user is not a collision. A valid provider answer survives an accounting outage instead of forcing a paid retry.

A credential failure opens only that user's circuit while another user keeps working; repeated outages open the provider globally. State is persisted in SQLite. After a fake-clock cooldown exactly one half-open probe is granted, a second is refused, a probe whose completion is lost recovers when its bounded lease expires, and a downstream or cross-scope denial releases the probe it did not use.
